provenance.edition-pin: material-web is a TOKENS-ONLY clone — there is no live M3 autocomplete component to grep for structure or behavior, so every structure/behavior claim here is [R] and every style value is [S] from a token file. PINNED TO tokens/versions/v0_192, per CLAUDE.md's now-settled decision ('M3 pins the v0.192 token edition, everywhere') — this column does not re-litigate the edition debate select.m3.json's own provenance flagged five times.
provenance.filled-and-outlined-are-one-component: tokens/versions/v0_192/_md-comp-{filled,outlined}-autocomplete.scss share their vocabulary almost line for line with each other AND with select's own {filled,outlined}-select.scss — identical text-field-input-text-*, label-text-*, supporting-text-*, error-*, disabled-*, hover-state-layer-* families and an identical menu-* family, confirmed by direct comparison. They differ in exactly two mechanisms: filled has an active indicator, outlined has an outline — the structure.indicator axis.
provenance.outlined-autocomplete-IS-filled-too: _md-comp-outlined-autocomplete.scss ALSO carries `text-field-container-color: md-sys-color.surface-container-highest`, identical to filled — re-confirming SELECT-MATRIX.md Finding 1's surprise on a second M3 component rather than assuming it carries over. See COMBOBOX-MATRIX.md Finding 5.
provenance.no-wrapper-override-so-filled-focus-indi: UNLIKE select, autocomplete has NO hand-authored, edition-independent tokens/_md-comp-{filled,outlined}-autocomplete.scss override file anywhere in the clone (confirmed: no such file exists at the top level of tokens/, only the versioned ones). select's filled variant thickens to 3px on focus ONLY because material-web's own hand-authored wrapper overrides the generated 2px token via _get-override-tokens(). Autocomplete has no such wrapper, so its filled variant's focus-active-indicator-height stays at the versioned file's own literal 2px — confirmed by direct read of _md-comp-filled-autocomplete.scss line ~135, `if($exclude-hardcoded-values, null, 2px)`. A real, sourced divergence FROM select's own filled column, not a copy-paste carryover.
provenance.leading-icon-size-divergence-not-modelle: filled-autocomplete's text-field-leading-icon-size is 20px, where select's (and outlined-autocomplete's own) is 24px — a real, grepped divergence. This column declares no start-adornment row for combobox at all (see COMBOBOX-MATRIX.md scope/structure), so the number is recorded here as a documented finding (COMBOBOX-MATRIX.md Finding 5) rather than a live cell; a future session adding a start-adornment row should use 20px filled / 24px outlined, not select's flat 24px.
provenance.trigger-bg / trigger-bg-hover / trigger-: IDENTICAL token chain and IDENTICAL resolved values to select.m3.json's own slots of the same name — same md-sys-color dependencies, same v0.192 pin, cross-checked line for line against both autocomplete files.
provenance.popup-bg / popup-fg / popup-shadow / opt: IDENTICAL to select.m3.json's own values, via the SAME cross-file borrow chain (autocomplete's own menu-* family plus the versions/v0_192/_md-comp-list.scss re-point select.m3.json's own provenance documents in full) — autocomplete's menu-* keys are byte-identical to select's own.
provenance.type-body / type-option: trigger: text-field-input-text-* -> body-large (1rem/1.5rem, weight-regular 400). Option: menu-list-item-label-text-* -> label-large (0.875rem/1.25rem, weight-medium 500) — identical roles to select's own trigger/option typography.
